description: Two gated noise sources sharing one white-noise generator, each with its own noise colour, its own logic condition and its own level

params.text: Chooses the noise colour for the right-hand channel, which feeds Out 2: pink, white or brown; the maker's tooltip for it reads Noise L mode
Chooses the noise colour for the left-hand channel, which feeds Out 1: pink, white or brown; the maker's tooltip for it reads Noise R mode
Chooses which logic condition has to hold between Signal A and Signal B before that channel's noise reaches its output: AND, OR, XOR, NAND, NOR or XNOR
Sets that channel's output level as a percentage from 0 to 100; it comes up at 1, which is almost silent

inputs.text: One of the two logic inputs; it counts as high above 5V and low at or below it

outputs.text: The noise for that channel while its logic condition holds, and 0V while it does not

notes: both Vol knobs come up at 1 out of 100, so a fresh module is almost silent until they are turned up.
the two channels are fed from one white-noise draw per sample, so with both colour switches in the same position the two outputs carry the same signal.
the pink filter state and the brown integrator are shared by both channels, so two channels set to the same colour track each other exactly.
the two colour switches wear each other's tooltips: the switch on the left is named Noise R mode and feeds Out 1, and the one on the right is named Noise L mode and feeds Out 2.
a channel set to brown fades over about 12 samples when its logic condition changes; pink and white switch instantly.
the two lamps beside the input jacks light while Signal A and Signal B are above 5V.
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and each output carries one channel.

inputs.0: high above 5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 5V · stepped · one channel only
